# mimecast_delivery_route_definitions (Data Source)

Read all delivery route definitions with cursor pagination. Authentication passwords are never returned or stored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_delivery_route_definitions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `alternate_route_id` (String) Alternate route ID.
- `auth_mechanisms` (List of String) SMTP authentication mechanisms.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `domain` (String) SMTP authentication domain.
- `hostname` (String) Destination host.
- `id` (String) Definition ID.
- `port` (Number) Destination port.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) SMTP authentication username.
